items.title: SipWorks introduces LockSeal lid for the Metro Commuter Tumbler
items.summary: SipWorks announced that Metro tumblers shipped after October 20 include the new LockSeal lid, which it describes as 'leak-proof in your bag'. The announcement does not mention price changes.

items.title: TrailForge launches 'Everyday Expedition' campaign
items.summary: TrailForge says its new campaign shows how expedition gear fits daily routines like commuting and office work. No new products or prices are announced.

items.title: Ridge bottle now available in two new colors
items.summary: PeakTrail added 'Glacier' and 'Ember' colors to the Ridge line. The post does not mention pricing, promotions, or lid changes.

items.title: Forum rumor: 'PeakTrail is dumping Ridge inventory before a redesign'
items.summary: An anonymous forum user claims, without evidence, that PeakTrail cut the Ridge price to clear stock before a redesign. No other source corroborates this claim.
